correctness.rationale: Probability-normalized S^3 addition gives K_l(x,z)=(l+1)U_l(<x,z>). Opposite-node parity reduces the 24-point Gram to twice the 12-point block. The even root-line graph is a J_2 blowup of L(K_4), with exact adjacency eigenvalues 8(1), -4(2), 0(9). The odd signed Gram uses M M*=6I and S=M*M-2I, giving 4(4), -2(8). The resulting formulas produce every rank through degree ten; uniform inequalities give positivity in all even degrees >=12 and all odd degrees >=5. The degree-ten defect proves sharpness of the all-degree threshold at eleven; simultaneous equality of sector eigenvalues proves tightness iff odd l=5 modulo 6 among full-rank degrees. The reproducing-kernel pseudoinverse gives the exact minimal-norm interpolation formula. CHECK.py passed 399 degree/spectral/rank assertions and further exact geometry and projector identities using rational arithmetic; it is corroboration, not a proof of infinitely many degrees.

value.rationale: The 24-cell is a canonical sharp spherical root configuration for harmonic designs. Its exact fixed-degree recoverability is a motivated inverse-sampling invariant, distinct from design mean cancellation. The spectrum proves nonmonotone sampling ranks, isolates the last failure at degree ten, yields a sharp permanent threshold eleven, supplies explicit data-space projectors/pseudoinverse interpolation, and identifies an infinite arithmetic progression of precisely conditioned tight bands. These conclusions have natural reconstruction significance and are not merely a tiny numerical table or a change of notation.
